items.title: Basket vs Football
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
The time has come for a wild fun game between opposing sports. Choose your favorite animal and team to face your opponents with the best style.

- There are 16 different animal skins to choose from.

By Kuboc Studios.

items.title: Froggy Teens
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Ribbit! Ribbit! These teens are sporting outfits of one of their favorite animals. Why don't you hippity hop on over and chill by the pond with everyone?

items.title: Elemental Powers
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: These teens wield mystical powers in their hands. The power they possess is beautiful but dangerous! Learn to control the elements and become the greatest elemental master ever to live!

items.title: Arena Legends
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
With their revolutionary technology that allows them to clone and thrive independently, robots have totally taken over the land in this new century. Step into an epic arena teeming with the most powerful warriors! Fight for freedom with the red team or fight for justice with the blue team!

- PVP, PVE and co-op
- Single or multiplayer
- Normal and hardcore mode
- 4 skins

items.title: Autumn Teen Anime
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Show off your autumn style with these fashionable anime teens. A trendy expression for all! 10 skins for you and your friends to choose from.

items.title: Animal Rescue Team
items.creator: House of How
items.description: The Animal Rescue Team is made up of medics, rescuers, and furry friends. Everyday is an adventure providing safety and care for nature and humans in need. Show off your love for all living things and pick your favorite skins out of this pack of 12 today!

items.title: SCP [Redacted] HD
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
SCP [Redacted] HD. Check out Dr. Gears, SCP-1007, SCP-111, SCP-1504, SCP-387, SCP-040, SCP-096 and more! 

CC-BY-SA

items.title: Advanced Skyblock Minions
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Collect resources, buy coins and unlock new minions. Use them to obtain blocks so you can expand your skyblock! Upgrade the minions so they are more productive. Unlock new sky islands to get new blocks which you can use to get even more miners, farmers, lumberjackers and shovelers!

+Buy & sell shop!
+8 skyblock islands!
+35+ unique minions!
+Advanced level system!

items.title: Defend the Door
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Defend the door from withered pigs, cows, chickens, and more! Strategically build towers to combat the incoming wither army. Place upgrades on top of towers for more defense, like the creeper catapult, or the pirate cannon. Fight alongside your builds with a sword or bow.
- 16 towers and upgrades
- 9 withered mobs
- 3 difficulties
- 5 skins

Tower defense like gameplay.

items.title: Cyber Demons
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Futuristic style, electro inverted vibe, let your horns glow!

- Stylish cyber ghouls
- 20 neon skins
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Construction Workers
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Roleplay as a construction worker and get the job done! Be sure to grab your hard hats and stay safe while building your next house!

items.title: Trendy Outfits
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Show off all your cool skins with these trendy outfits! Designed by the greatest of Minecrafters, these skins are sure to make you stand out and wow your friends!

items.title: Farm Animal Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Welcome to Farm Animal Teens! Roleplay as an animal from a farm! Multiple to choose from!

items.title: Free Choice Vogue Teens
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Cool teens with trendy outfits! Choose your favorite style and the stage is yours!

+8 trendy teen skins!
+By FALL Studios

items.title: One Chunk Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
A new Lucky Blocks challenge is waiing for you! Destroy the Lucky Blocks and get ready for 300 different outcomes!

+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Neon Fashion
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Are you ready to walk around the totally elegant futuristic city? Dress like in the future with these 10 skins!

+ 2 free skins

items.title: Hotel Manager
items.creator: Pixelbiester
items.description:
Are you ready to become the manager of your very own hotel? Renovate suites and place furniture in luxurious rooms. Choose from various furniture options to create your own style. Organize your hotel and earn loads of money.

+ More than 130 furniture options
+ Fast cars and jetskis
+ Modern luxury hotel
+ Underwater rooms and more
+ Interactive gameplay
+ 2 free skins

items.title: Plaid Fall
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Casual clothing, cool bandanas, plaid fashion! Get ready and stay in style this fall season!

+ 10 teen skins
+ Outfits perfect for fall!

items.title: Seriously Stylish
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Look your best in these awesome outfits! Your friends are sure to be jealous.

+ 12 teen skins
+ Stylish clothing

items.title: OP Planets
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Welcome to a galaxy made out of the most valuable riches. Bridge to the distant planets, and find hidden shulker boxes filled with expensive loots.

- 6 unique planets; made out of emeralds, lapis, diamonds, redstone and iron
- Spawn next to a chest filled with basic tools.

items.title: Blingy Suits
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Tired of the usual streetwear skins or want something slick, stylish, and formal? You're in the right place! Pick your favorite skin that SUITS your needs and rock the fashion game on any Minecraft server! From vibrant colors to dark demon-themed teens, this pack has it all!

- 12 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Silly Geese
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
An end to your suffering;
a solution to your despair.
These goose skins by Yeggs
are covered in hair.
Fly away from your troubles
and turn a blind eye.
Buy these eight fuzzy fliers
and take to the sky.

+ Includes 8 boomdiculous skins!

items.title: Cave & Cliff Miners
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
What’s mine is yours and what’s yours is Miners: the new skinpack from Yeggs! Be Caves-and-Cliffs ready with these new amethyst and copper-themed miner skins!

+ Includes 8 boomstonishing skins!

items.title: Unicorns
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Have you ever dreamed of having your very own unicorn farm? Go to the hairdresser and get a new style for your unicorns. Complete three racing challenges to win trophies and impress your friends. 

+ 9 unique styles for the unicorn 
+ 3 different racing challenges to complete
+ 3 custom trophies to win and decorate with
+ Custom music

Created by Mine-North
